purpose: Keep release bookkeeping consistent when Vercel preview status and the custom-domain production path use different deployment labels.
releaseEvidenceOrder: merged main commit containing the treatment
live custom-domain verification of the affected route or behavior

rules.releaseDate: Use the date the merged treatment is confirmed on the live custom-domain route. If confirmation occurs the same day as merge, use the merge date.
rules.searchExperimentWindow: Begin the first complete day after release and preserve the repository experiment freeze rules.
rules.agentCoordination: Before changing a release record, refresh open PRs and recent main commits so another agent's in-flight work is not mislabeled as released.

knownTopology.vercelRole: Preview and deployment validation are visible in GitHub checks; the Vercel target=production label must not be used by itself to date custom-domain releases.
